get_world_info: get the current WorldInfo from the dependency resolver with rank, size, local_rank, and local_size
create_worldinfo_from_env: create a WorldInfo instance from an Environment object by reading RANK, WORLD_SIZE, LOCAL_RANK, and LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE env vars
review_worldinfo_dataclass: review the frozen WorldInfo dataclass that holds rank, size, local_rank, and local_size for distributed training
test_worldinfo_from_env_validation: test WorldInfo.from_env to validate that RANK and WORLD_SIZE must be specified together and RANK must be less than WORLD_SIZE
summarize_worldinfo_defaults: summarize how WorldInfo.from_env defaults rank to 0 and world_size to 1 when no env vars are set
